OPENCTI_URL.description: The base URL of the OpenCTI instance.

OPENCTI_TOKEN.description: The API token to connect to OpenCTI.

CONNECTOR_LOG_LEVEL.description: The minimum level of logs to display.

BITDEFENDER_FEEDS.description: Bitdefender reputation feeds to import. When supplied as an environment variable, use a comma-separated list such as file,web,ip.

BITDEFENDER_HTTP_TIMEOUT_SECONDS.description: HTTP timeout in seconds for downloading feeds.

BITDEFENDER_VERIFY_TLS.description: Verify the server TLS certificate when downloading feeds.

BITDEFENDER_MIN_CONFIDENCE.description: Minimum confidence level of imported feed entries (1–99). Entries must also meet the minimum severity.

BITDEFENDER_MAX_LOOKBACK_INTERVAL.description: Maximum lookback interval in seconds for feed retrieval (60-86400)

BITDEFENDER_MIN_SEVERITY.description: Minimum severity level of imported feed entries (1–99). Entries must also meet the minimum confidence.

BITDEFENDER_EXCLUDE_RELATED_INDICATORS.description: Exclude related indicators from the imported feeds.

BITDEFENDER_EXCLUDE_SIMILAR_FILES.description: Exclude similar-file indicators from the file reputation feed.

BITDEFENDER_INCLUDE_SUSPICIOUS.description: Whether to import suspicious file-feed entries: true (include), false (exclude), or only (import only suspicious entries).

BITDEFENDER_INCLUDE_REVOKED.description: Whether to import revoked entries: true (include), false (exclude), or only (import only revoked entries).

BITDEFENDER_CREATE_MALWARE_OBJECTS.description: Create Malware entities for individual file detections (true), or only for malware families (false).

BITDEFENDER_TLP_LEVEL.description: Default TLP marking applied to imported intelligence objects and relationships.
